Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of Work : Item Sl No 1 Job includes the following: (i) Data Collection & Entry related to production & despatch. (ii) Preparation of various Reports daily ,monthly & yearly related to production & despatch (iii) Compile/Update Data pertaining to production & despatch (iv) Entry of Incoming and Outgoing Daks in Register(s). Movement of papers and files betwe en the sections as and when required Item Sl No 2 Job includes the following: (i) Data Collection related to EC/CTO/FC compliance in respect to Environmental Monitoring (ii) Site Preparation for CAT structure / Plantation / any civil or forestry work related to SSW CP (iii) Date collection from Site visit related to civil/ forestry/environmental work related to SSW CP , CAT in respect to approved Site Plan (iv) Data collection and log book preparation from Tree enumeration/Tree felling/ de- siltation/ de-weeding (v) Updating of lease pillars status/ bore hole position status (vi) GPS Data collection from Reclamation & Rehabilitation Site inside Mining Pit (vii) Any other data collection required for compliance purpose to MoEFCC, DMO, DDM, State Forest Department, Vidhan Sabha/ Parliamentary Committee Item Sl No 3 Job includes the following: (i) Data entry for EC/FC/CTO/CTE compliance (ii) Data entry for Environment Statement, BMW return, Battery Return, Hazardous waste (iii) Data entry for Environment Performance Report & Star Rating (iv) Data entry for progress report as demanded by concerned authority Item Sl No 4 Job includes the following: (i) Maintaining MVT Database. (ii) Processing MVT data for NEX and Contractual workmen of KIOM & MIOM for Basic & Refre

sher MVT including form-1, Form-2, form-3, form-4, form-5, form-6 and form-7 and reports to DGMS including Quarterly return, Annual return and other required information as per Mines Act, Rules and Regulations there under. (iii) Preparation of HRDC database and for reporting to BSL HQ, MTI, Corporate office and oth ers. (iv) Maintaining Database for Mandatory training for different grade of executives. (v) Maintaining database for Apprentices of JGOM. (vi) Assisting in the computer Laboratory and helping coordinator organizing In-House progra mmes. (vii) Keeping the Training records of External Training, Feedback sheets, Pre-Post Exam inations details and records of day to day trainings conducted at HRDC. Item Sl No 5 Job includes the following: (i) Data entry for MVT & HRDC Database. (ii) Data entry for MVT data for Basic & Refresher MVT. (iii) Data entry for Mandatory training for different grade of executives. (iv) Data entry for Apprentices of JGOM. (v) Assisting in the computer Laboratory and helping coordinator organizing In-House progra mmes. (vi) Data entry for Training records of External Training, Feedback sheets, Pre-Post Examinat ions details and records of day to day trainings conducted at HRDC. Item Sl No 6 Job includes the following: (i) Provision of support hand required to look after the DG Set, classrooms, conference halls , model room,12000sq ft garden, library etc, lock and unlock the classrooms, conference h alls, office etc, (ii) Look after the accessories of L&DC against theft or damage, ensure un authorized entry d uring and after office hours, (iii) Prohibit the entry of animals into L&DC campus, up-keeping of office accessories, reshuffl ing of classroom activities, house-keeping, putting on & off the area and office lightings, a ttending guests and dignitaries as and when required and any other jobs as required. 2.
